text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shopping mall with Transcend
to check out the latest gadgets, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It just didn't click with me~.
Even that flashlight-spoon combo thing—its sense was so avant-garde, which should've been right up my alley.
choice_data_list: Then how about watching a movie for a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A movie, huh... Hmmm, right now I don't really
feel confident I can concentrate on the screen."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...What's this? Is my heart in sleep mode?
Is my brain's excitement radar undergoing maintenance or somethin'~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps Transcend is losing her curiosity due to fatigue from racing. It looks like we'll need to reconsider our upcoming racing schedule."
